Haiti, a nation on the island of Hispaniola in the Caribbean, was once the most populous and the most affluent country in the hemisphere.

At its height in the mid-19th century, Haiti, the world’s first black-ruled country, sent more of its students to study in Europe than Cuba, Jamaica, Guyana, Surinam, and the Portuguese colonies of Brazil combined.
However, due to poverty, natural disasters, poor agricultural practices, and an extreme gap in wealth, the majority of the population live in absolute poverty (UNICEF Haiti.
The United Nations Human Development Index rates Haiti as one of the poorest countries in the world.
The literacy rate in Haiti is a mere 47%, and the majority of the population has no access to healthcare or clean drinking water (UNICEF Haiti, 2010).
With the lack of education, wealth, power, and access to healthcare, women of Haiti feel a lack of control over their lives.

In the past few years, the restaurant and catering industries in Africa have grown rapidly, particularly in the urban and suburban areas.

sentences.sentence: year since Google Inc. officially opened for business.
Throughout these years, Google Inc. has been the leader in web search with over seventy percent market share.
It does not appear that any other search engine will be able to compete with Google any time soon.
In 2009, two new search engines were released with very high expectations.
These new search engines were Wolfram Alpha (WA) and Microsoft Bing.
Neither WA or Bing was able to overtake Google.
It seems as if WA’s potential is still largely untapped and will have a long road to achieving the same amount of success as Google.
This report will take a closer look at WA, discuss whether its weaknesses may be easily overcome, and make some recommendations about future use.
Description of the community
The community that WA may have the greatest influence on is mathematics and science.
WA is capable of answering a wide array of mathematical questions.
There are also many science specific computations that can be completed with WA such as chemical element properties, chemistry, biology, and astronomy.
Some of the more general information that WA can access for questions is geography, history, weather, stocks, and sports.
With such a wide range of content available on the web, WA is limited in the amount of content that can be included into its own database.
The most useful feature of WA is that it is possible for anyone with some programming experience and an internet connection to write a WA pod and add information to the WA database.
The majority of the community is involved in this process.
Some people who are involved in the community are Wolfram Inc. employees, other programmers, and members of the WA forum.

Nurses have been at the front line in identifying and addressing the issues that affect the health of the community they serve (Janz et al., 2017).
As the world continues to develop, so do the health issues in the society.
New risks and factors that have been brought in by the developing society, are affecting the health of many individuals and it is the role of health care workers to address these health issues.
Drug and substance abuse is one of the many health issues that are affecting the general population (Janz et al., 2017).

Drugs have become a daily part of life for many individuals, and while there is a fine line between taking the drug for medicinal purposes and drug abuse, it is essential that healthcare workers can identify the differences to offer necessary interventions.
Many drugs are taken by individuals for different reasons, most of the time to get an emotional feeling and relief.

Many of these drugs can lead to substance abuse and addiction, making it difficult for individuals to get out of the cycle of drugs, and in most cases, leads to severe health complications or even death (Janz et al., 2017).

The aim of this report is to explain the issues around the drug abuse and the substance abuse within the city of Melbourne as well as explain the current policies and resources to address this problem.
Characteristics of the City of Melbourne
Melbourne has a population of approximately 5.1 million people, making it one of the largest Australian cities (TheCityOfMelbourne, 2020).

sentences.sentence: traditional uses of music in Christian worship services are analyzed.
The three traditional uses of music in Christian worship services are the teachings for believers, music as a show of dedication to God, and encouragement.
One way in which music is used in Christian worship services is to teach believers.
For instance, in the book of Exodus, the Israelites were singing songs that depicted their victory over the Egypt army (Goff 56).
In modern music, the purpose is the same.
For instance, songs such as “You are my strength,” is used by Christian musicians to show how God’s love is a source of strength for believers.
As a result, Christians are taught to rely on God for strength, instead of material objects like gold and silver.
In another example, the book of Psalms contains several songs that Christians use to praise God.
By using the same lyrics, Christians are able to learn and be taught new songs that express gratitude.
The lyrics of Psalms were used by Christians to teach them how they ought to respond to God’s faithfulness (Goff 56).
Today, the songs are used to remind Christians of God’s unfailing love and how they ought to reciprocate that love by praising and glorifying Him.
Additionally, Christian worship music in used as a way of showing dedication to God.
The purpose of this is to express to God the appreciation and dedication that believers have for Him.
According to (Goff 67), music has been used as a way of showing reverence for God by the church from time immemorial.
For example, David, a well-known leader, praised God for His faithfulness in every way.
His songs and Psalms are still used in the modern church to appreciate and adore God, showing that it is a traditional aspect of Christian worship.

The main problem is that the location where people live can determine how their health will be affected (Alvarez & Bertoni, 2019).
As a result, it is crucial to investigate the influence of zip codes on people’s health and, if necessary, improve the infrastructure of areas with lower-quality services in terms of medical care.
In addition, it is important to determine if people are aware of the impact of their zip code on health and how they cope with potential risks.
The research question is as follows: How does the quality of a zip code impact the health of its residents?
This question is not that new in terms of being studied.
However, this investigation will be limited to considering the views of people regarding the problem.
It will be critical to analyze which health-related services or infrastructure can be used to measure the impact of the zip codes’ quality.
In addition, the study will assess the views of people regarding the quality of infrastructure in the zip codes that they inhabit and determine the impact it has on their health.
Moreover, it is crucial to determine if they are aware of potential risks and are trying to prevent them.
A total of 30 people (15 men and 15 women) aged 20-40 will be included in the study.
To participate, they should not have chronic diseases and live in areas with a population of more than 150,000 people.
While the sample size can be argued as small, it is still big enough to be representative of the target audience.
A survey questionnaire (see Appendix A) will be used in the study.
